checks: Every implemented owner route passes the shared shell consumer checks, including dashboard and analytics. Workbench enters actual access statistics by keyboard. Normal/recycled historical ranking entries navigate to their actual library/trash URLs with the exact image ID; permanently deleted history exposes no navigation or content.
limitations: Only disposable runner records, objects and one private Token upload are used; the manual preview is independent.
HTTP/network/health faults and visibility/timer controls are explicit page-boundary injections; normal analytics responses come from the real production server and are reconciled with SQLite.
Viewport and keyboard emulation do not prove physical touch or software keyboard behavior. Human design acceptance remains separate.
